title: WeKnora Agent Plugin configuration
description: Authoritative schema for ${PLUGIN_DATA}/config.json, loaded via --config by the local stdio MCP server. See docs/notes/configuration.md for normalization and startup failure behavior.

$schema.description: Optional editor-only hint pointing to the config schema shipped with the plugin. The runtime ignores it and never fetches it; remove or adjust the path after copying the example outside the plugin package.

baseUrl.description: Absolute http/https URL with a non-empty hostname; the WeKnora API root may omit the /api/v1 suffix, which is normalized at load time.

apiKey.description: API key sent as X-API-Key. Omit only for deployments that do not require authentication. Sensitive: keep this file out of the published package.

tenantId.description: Workspace id sent as X-Tenant-ID; required only for platform-scoped API keys.

knowledgeBaseIds.description: Default knowledge-base scope when a call names none. Call arguments override it; it is NOT a permission allow-list.

agentId.description: Default custom agent for weknora_ask; omit to use the server-side RAG pipeline. Availability and permissions are constrained by the server.

maxResults.description: Default and maximum number of search hits and ask references.

maxChunkChars.description: Per-chunk character budget; document reading clips concatenated text to ten times this value.

chatTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for the whole ask SSE stream, including model and tool execution time.

resourceUrls.description: public asks WeKnora for directly loadable file URLs; handle keeps internal references. A 403 that explicitly names resource_urls=public downgrades that process to handle mode.

tools.description: Per-tool registration switches; omitted entries default to true. At least one tool must stay enabled.
